description.value: CHOCHO Hot Pot is a premium all-you-can-eat individual hot pot restaurant founded in 2023, part of a small chain with locations in Burnaby and two US cities. Guests choose from over 60 fresh ingredients, multiple broths, and a contemporary upscale setting designed for group gatherings and special occasions. The menu explicitly accommodates vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diners, making it a solid option for mixed-diet cycling groups seeking a substantial sit-down meal.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands at 16m; rack at 19m; rack at 32m; rack at 82m; rack at 86m; rack at 90m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active CHOCHO Hot Pot location at 4151 Hazelbridge Wy Suite 1150, Richmond BC, with phone (604) 285-8161, fully consistent with OSM address tags. The /discover subpage explicitly states the menu includes 'vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options' among 60+ items, supporting a true value for that amenity. No website content addresses bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, or device charging, so those remain null.
concerns: Phone number (604) 285-8161 was sourced from the website only; OSM has no phone field for this record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with confirmed address and active website; a viable meal stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.
